goal:
Repair only the independently reproduced false CAPTCHA refusals in delivered base00669e94-caad-4866-b487-dfe359bec458, manifest89ab0e1ec178e88376ea09076cd54af076b371170cc5cf775e036dcf46df4907. The new challengeMessage scan in browser/captcha-document.ts treats ordinary property text and non-rendered JSON as page challenges. The following cases must verify access with200 after a real collector-triggered CAPTCHA pause, without any verification navigation, then permit explicit resume with new collection navigation:

1. A parser-valid matching detail record whose description and visible article/paragraph both say "A security check at the main entrance is included in the condominium service."
2. A parser-valid matching detail record whose description and visible article/paragraph both say "The previous tenant reports a human verification required sign next to the entrance turnstile."
3. A parser-valid search document followed by a non-rendered script type="application/json" containing {"description":"The concierge documents human verification for visitor badges."}, with no real page challenge.

Preserve every established control: five ordinary Cloudflare/challenge/turnstile description positives (including raw JSON and visible echoes), two genuine marked challenge envelopes plus valid parser metadata, and three unmarked main/section/paragraph challenge messages plus valid empty-search metadata. Real challenges must keep403, durable CAPTCHA and zero verification navigation. Keep document URL, context and detail identity checks; unresolved, unreadable, closed or wrong-context documents remain refused. Do not make parser metadata alone override a real challenge, use a fixture-only tag/id exemption, or weaken assertions to pass. Keep current search/empty-search parsing, explicit resume and fixture403/approve/page2 flow.

The existing integration test forces startControlServer through an unknown double cast because its .d.ts omits the session option the JavaScript implementation already supports. Accurately type the supported injectable session or use an already typed production-compatible factory; remove that unknown/any escape while retaining the executed HTTP/state/navigation assertions.

Only offline synthetic fixtures and package registries. No live property-site traffic, personal browser profiles or real-site cookies; synthetic fixture cookies are allowed. Do not import or execute collect-spitogatos.mjs. No hosting, client acceptance or publication. Preserve collect-xe-live.js and import-spitogatos-browser.js and all48 data/evidence files byte-for-byte and mode-for-mode against this base. Keep all original ordinary test coverage with only the two original separate browser exclusions. Verify ordinary npm ci, npm run check and npm run build in a disposable final-source executable clean copy excluding itself, node_modules, dist, .git and .atoma reference/scratch/read-run directories. Record actual final-source command exits. The separate known Chromium dependency/cleanup problem is reserved for a later bounded run; do not modify that harness here or claim whole-browser success.

acceptance_checklist.behaviour: Visible ordinary property descriptions mentioning security checks or human verification return200 after a real CAPTCHA pause.
Non-rendered JSON description text allows access verification on a parser-valid search document without a real challenge.
All ten existing envelope controls retain their outcomes, durable challenge refusals and zero verification navigation.
The HTTP integration test injects its supported session through accurate declared types without an unknown or any cast.
Ordinary npm ci, check and build pass in a clean executable copy with full original ordinary test coverage.
collect-xe-live.js, import-spitogatos-browser.js and all48 data/evidence files retain their base bytes and modes.
